This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

Qualifications

• Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.
• Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.
• Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
• Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.
• Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.
• Clear written and spoken communication skills.

Desired:

• Experience working on customer-facing applications.
• Good debugging skills on production systems.
• Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.
• Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.
Location
This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
.

Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
description:
## Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations
We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.
## About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/
Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.
Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.
Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.
## What you'll do
You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.
## 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness
Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.
Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.
Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).
Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.
Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.
Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.
## 2. Clinical knowledge base
Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.
Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.
Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.
Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.
Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.
Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.
By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.
## What we're looking for
We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.
## Must-haves
Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.
Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.
Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.
Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.
Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.
Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.
Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.
## Nice to have
Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.
A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.
Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).
Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.
Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.
Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.
## Probably not the right fit if
You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.
You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.
This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster.
In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries.
We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further.
## 🌲 About Spruce
Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.
We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.
We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. title: Data Engineer - Databricks Platform
description:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
Your Role
Passionate about building modern data platforms and transforming complex data into meaningful business insights? At Kyndryl, our Data Engineers design, develop, and optimize scalable data solutions that enable organizations to make informed, data-driven decisions.
As a Data Engineer specializing in Databricks, you will play a critical role in architecting and maintaining enterprise data platforms that support advanced analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and business intelligence initiatives. You will work across cloud environments, integrating diverse data sources and creating reliable data pipelines that deliver trusted, high-quality information to stakeholders.
This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, modern data architectures, and large-scale data engineering projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve business challenges through data innovation.
What You Will Do
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts using Databricks and cloud-native technologies.
• Build and optimize Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) processes to ensure high-quality, reliable, and accessible data.
• Integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring scalability, compliance, security, and adherence to data governance standards.
• Develop backend data services and application programming interfaces (APIs) to support data-driven applications and analytics solutions.
• Collaborate with Data Architects, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Developers, and Analytics teams to deliver business-focused data solutions.
• Support Agile delivery practices, continuous integration, code reviews, and operational excellence across the data platform lifecycle.
Your Future at Kyndryl
As a Data Engineer, you will have opportunities to deepen your expertise in modern cloud data platforms, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence initiatives. You can grow into roles such as Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Cloud Data Architect, Analytics Lead, or Technical Delivery Leader. Through continuous learning, certifications, and hands-on project experience, you will build highly sought-after skills in data engineering and digital transformation.
Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are eager to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, prioritize customer success, and naturally collaborate across diverse teams and stakeholders.
Required Skills and Experience
• Hands-on experience designing and developing data engineering solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Structured Query Language (SQL), and Python.
• Proven experience building and supporting Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) pipelines in cloud environments such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Strong knowledge of data warehousing, data lakes, data marts, data virtualization, and modern data architecture principles.
• Experience working with relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage platforms, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
• Understanding of data governance, security, access controls, data quality management, and regulatory compliance requirements.
• Familiarity with Agile development practices, application programming interfaces (APIs), version control, continuous integration, and collaborative software engineering methodologies.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Experience with Microsoft Fabric and lakehouse architecture.
• Knowledge of Apache Kafka, Apache Hadoop, or other big data technologies.
• Experience developing real-time and streaming data solutions.
• Exposure to web data extraction and automation technologies.
• Understanding of data modelling, analytics platforms, and business intelligence solutions.
• Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications.
Being You
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Red Hat OpenShift & Linux Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title: Systems Engineer (Red Hat OpenShift & Linux)
Role Overview
We are looking for an SRE-oriented Systems & Platform Engineer to manage, automate, and support production Red Hat OpenShift and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments across hybrid cloud and enterprise infrastructure. You will handle L2/L3 incident and problem resolution, patching, upgrades, and operational automation to maintain high availability and meet client SLAs.
Key Responsibilities
OpenShift & Linux Operations (L2/L3): Administer, monitor, patch, harden, and upgrade Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers and Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters in production managed-services environments.
Incident, Problem & Change Management: Investigate and resolve complex infrastructure incidents within SLA using ServiceNow and ITIL workflows, conduct root-cause analysis (RCA), and execute approved change requests and maintenance windows.
Automation & SRE Improvements: Automate routine operational and patching tasks using Ansible, CI/CD, and scripting (Bash, Python, or PowerShell), analyzing ticket trends to reduce manual toil.
Escalation & Stakeholder Coordination: Lead initial operational escalations, support L1 teams with triage, coordinate with internal CoEs and external vendors/TACs, and maintain clear shift handovers.
Resiliency & Project Support: Support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing, configuration updates, and infrastructure deployment projects as required.
Qualifications & Certifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/Computing or equivalent hands-on industry experience.
Certifications:
Active Red Hat Linux System Administration certification (e.g., RHCSA or RHCE).
Active Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) administration certification (e.g., EX280).
Core Experience:
Hands-on production Linux (RHEL) system administration (installation, configuration, patching, security hardening, monitoring, and troubleshooting).
Hands-on Red Hat OpenShift (OCP) cluster administration (cluster operations, upgrades, patching, monitoring, and application deployment support).
Experience working in ITIL-aligned managed services using ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
Good-to-Have Skills (Advantageous, Not Mandatory)
Cloud & Virtualization: AWS, Nutanix, VMware vSphere, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Veeam.
Cross-Technology & Monitoring: Windows Server (Active Directory / Domain Services, SQL Server), Apache web server, BigFix, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), F5 Load Balancers, and SNMP.
Automation & Scripting: Ansible, REST APIs, JSON, CI/CD pipelines, Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
Additional Certifications: VMware VCP, Veeam Certified Engineer, GCP, or SRE certifications

title: Cloud Specialist
description:
Overview
We are looking for a dynamic Cloud Specialist to drive cloud solution deployments, operational automation, and client-facing AI and Modern Workplace transformations across Singapore and Malaysia. Combining core cloud infrastructure engineering with specialized expertise in Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, Gemini, and Google Workspace, this role leads pre-sales technical orchestration, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), security/governance implementation, and end-to-end project delivery while contributing to regional business growth and team mentorship at PointStar.
Job Descriptions
Core Cloud Infrastructure & MOM SOL Duties
• Cloud Solution Deployment & Configuration: Deploy, configure, and integrate cloud solutions, secure landing zones, and Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls in accordance with approved architectural blueprints and client requirements.
• Cloud Operations Automation & Continuous Improvement: Automate cloud operations, develop and maintain infrastructure automation scripts (e.g., Terraform, Python, Bash), and participate in the continuous improvement of cloud solutions to optimize performance, security, and operational efficiency.
• Proof of Concepts (PoC) & Demonstrations: Participate in and lead the technical specification, environment setup, and execution of high-impact Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and demonstrations of cloud, AI, and Workspace solutions for prospective and existing clients.
• Virtual Platform Server Administration & Maintenance: Administer, configure, and maintain servers across virtual platforms and cloud environments, ensuring high availability, patch compliance, and reliable workload operations.
Strategic AI, Modern Workplace & Regional Delivery Duties
• Strategic AI & Workspace Leadership: Act as the lead advisor for clients seeking to embed AI into their business models; design and articulate practical AI roadmaps that integrate Google Cloud’s Vertex AI and Gemini with Google Workspace to drive organisational productivity.
• AI Productivity Transformation: Lead the strategy and execution for "Modern Workplace" initiatives; demonstrate and implement AI-driven productivity features within Google Workspace (Gemini for Workspace) to help clients automate content generation, data analysis in Sheets, and streamlined communication in Gmail and Meet.
• Security & Governance Oversight: Define and implement cloud security strategies, ensuring that AI, Data, and Workspace platforms comply with regional regulations (including PDPA in Singapore and Malaysia) through robust landing zones and IAM governance.
• Sales & Pre-Sales Orchestration: Partner with and lead the sales team in identifying and qualifying high-value opportunities; direct the creation of complex technical proposals (incorporating AI, Workspace Productivity, and Security) and deliver persuasive technical demos.
• Complex Project Delivery: Take end-to-end technical accountability for complex cloud migration, AI build, and Workspace transformation projects, leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver projects on time and to the highest standards of innovation and security.
• Regional Collaboration: Manage stakeholders and project delivery across both Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring a consistent and premium service experience for regional clients.
• Financial Accountability: Drive assigned Gross Profit (GP) targets for the regional business unit, ensuring sales and technical resources are utilized efficiently to maximize client value.
• Mentorship: Act as a mentor to senior and junior consultants, fostering a culture of technical excellence, security awareness, and AI innovation within PointStar.
Qualifications & Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s degree or recognized Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, cloud solution deployment, or technical consulting, with proven experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Workspace, and AI/data solutions.
Technical & Business Expertise:
• Strong hands-on proficiency in deploying and configuring Google Cloud solutions (Compute Engine, GKE, Vertex AI, IAM, Cloud Security) and Google Workspace enterprise environments.
• Practical experience developing infrastructure automation scripts (Terraform, Python, Apps Script, or Bash) and administering servers across virtualised and cloud platforms.
• Demonstrated track record in pre-sales solutioning, technical proposal development, running client PoCs, and managing project profitability (GP targets).
• Deep understanding of regional data privacy and compliance frameworks, specifically PDPA in Singapore and Malaysia.
• Certifications (Preferred): Google Cloud and Workspace certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Certified – Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or Google Workspace Administrator).
